title: Understanding Transformer-based Vision Models through Inversion
abstract: arXiv:2412.06534v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Understanding the internal mechanisms of deep neural networks remains a central challenge in machine learning. In computer vision, one promising yet only preliminarily explored approach is feature inversion via inverse networks, which reconstructs images from intermediate representations using trained inverse networks. In this study, we revisit feature inversion via inverse networks, introducing a novel, modular variant that enables a computationally more efficient application of the technique while, in some cases, producing semantically more coherent image reconstructions. We apply our method to large-scale transformer-based vision models, specifically Detection Transformer, Vision Transformer, Swin Transformer, and Data-Efficient Image Transformer, analyzing the resulting reconstructions across network depth. Our main analysis compares Detection Transformer and Vision Transformer, which exhibit the most informative difference

translated_title: 通过反演理解基于Transformer的视觉模型
translated_abstract: 理解深度神经网络的内部机制仍然是机器学习中的核心挑战。在计算机视觉领域，一种有前景但仅被初步探索的方法是通过逆向网络进行特征反演，即使用训练好的逆向网络从中间表示重建图像。在本研究中，我们重新审视了通过逆向网络进行特征反演的方法，提出了一种新颖的模块化变体，使该技术在计算上更加高效，并且在某些情况下能够生成语义上更加连贯的图像重建结果。我们将该方法应用于大规模基于Transformer的视觉模型，具体包括检测Transformer（Detection Transformer）、视觉Transformer（Vision Transformer）、Swin Transformer和数据高效图像Transformer（Data-Efficient Image Transformer），并分析了重建结果随网络深度的变化。我们的主要分析比较了检测Transformer和视觉Transformer，二者展现出最具信息量的差异。
tldr: 本文提出一种新颖的模块化特征反演方法，能更高效地从大规模Transformer视觉模型的中间表示重建语义更连贯的图像，并借此揭示了DETR与ViT等模型内部机制随网络深度的差异。
